'''Val-Aruun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] chef who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When making the foodstuff [[kaavo]], Val-Aruun always cut the product into tenths, despite the fact that all other chefs cut kaavo into sixths.
